competitors.name: Grocery retailers / AI and store technology
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer's 2026 Grocery Tech Trends Study found that nearly all surveyed grocery retailers expect technology investment to increase or stay flat this year, with nearly two-thirds planning to spend more than last year. The study is based on 70 retailers surveyed in March and April and highlights AI moving from experimentation toward implementation.

competitors.name: Schnuck Markets
competitors.action: Schnucks added two customer-facing digital tools: an AI shopping assistant on its app and website and a revamped interactive weekly ad. The assistant can build shopping lists, suggest meal ideas from ingredients customers have, and provide personalized nutrition guidance; the weekly ad lets shoppers clip coupons, add items to lists or carts, and view product details.

competitors.name: Ferrero Group / Purely Elizabeth
competitors.action: Ferrero Group signed an agreement to acquire Purely Elizabeth, a Boulder-based better-for-you breakfast brand with granola, oatmeal, cereal and protein products. Ferrero said it will support continued innovation, operations and expanded distribution while Purely Elizabeth remains a stand-alone brand led by founder and CEO Elizabeth Stein.

trends.topic: Grocery AI moving into shopper-facing execution
trends.magnitude: Nearly two-thirds of surveyed retailers plan higher tech spending in 2026
trends.context: Retailers are shifting AI from pilots toward digital shelf, shopping-list, promotion and nutrition use cases. Real Dough should keep product attributes, prep guidance, diet flags and promotion data complete for retailer systems.

trends.topic: Midwest grocers tying promotions to AI-assisted meal planning
trends.magnitude: Schnucks: 112 stores across Missouri, Illinois and Indiana
trends.context: Schnucks' AI assistant and interactive ad connect weekly deals, product details, shopping lists and carts. Premium frozen pizza discovery will increasingly depend on being readable as a meal solution inside retailer apps and ads.

trends.topic: Strategic buyers consolidating better-for-you pantry brands
trends.magnitude: Ferrero follows WK Kellogg deal with Purely Elizabeth acquisition agreement
trends.context: Scaled CPG companies continue buying premium wellness brands rather than only building them internally. This can raise distribution expectations and competitive support levels in natural and premium grocery sets.
